title: Arlo the Alligator Boy
overview: Upon learning that he is from New York City, a wide-eyed boy, who is half human and half alligator, decides to leave his sheltered life in the swamp and search for his long lost father. A musical adventure.

title: Barbie: Princess Adventure
overview: With new friends in a new kingdom, Barbie learns what it means to be herself when she trades places with a royal lookalike in this musical adventure.

title: Beat Bugs: All Together Now
overview: After winning a local talent show, the Beat Bugs journey to compete on "The Bug Factor," a televised singing contest held in faraway Rocket Ship Park.

title: Bebefinn Sing-Along Movie: Into the Pinkfong World
overview: In the middle of the night, Finn mysteriously vanishes into a tablet while playing Baby Shark Hide and Seek! As he explores the magical Pinkfong World in search of Baby Shark, Finn's worried siblings, Bora and Brody, turn to Pinkfong for help. Using magical powers and a can-do attitude, Pinkfong guides them through exciting challenges. But with the tablet’s battery draining fast, can they rescue Finn before Dad wakes up?

title: My Little Pony: A New Generation: Sing-Along
overview: A young pony makes a herd of new friends on a quest to bring magic back to her world in this sing-along version of "My Little Pony: A New Generation."

title: The Loud House Movie
overview: The Loud family travel to Scotland and discover they are descendants of Scottish royalty as they move into their giant ancestral castle.

title: The Twits
overview: When the meanest, nastiest villains pull a trick to take over their town, two brave children team up with a family of magical animals to bring them down.

title: Xico's Journey
overview: The peace of a small town is endangered when a corporation wants to destroy the mountain that protects them. A girl named Copi and her best friend Xico, a Xoloitzcuintle dog, will go into the mountains to try to save the town.
